description: Header file defining the AppGatewayImplementation class, which implements interfaces for app gateway resolution and configuration, including nested RespondJob class, with methods for configuration, event handling, message response, and internal resolution logic.

classes.name: AppGatewayImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing app gateway resolution and configuration interfaces, managing message dispatching, event handling, and internal resolution processes.

classes.name: RespondJob
classes.description: Nested class within AppGatewayImplementation responsible for dispatching responses, either returning messages via socket or sending to launch delegate.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the app gateway resolver with provided paths.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a request based on context, origin, method, and parameters, producing a result.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming events with context, alias, event name, origin, and listen flag.

methods.name: ReturnMessageInSocket
methods.description: Sends a message payload back through the socket if responder is available.

methods.name: SendToLaunchDelegate
methods.description: Sends payload to launch delegate with given context.

methods.name: ReadCountryFromConfigFile
methods.description: Reads country information from configuration file.
